lines.1: 「The student council's fine, and I've got something in my stomach. Time to go coach the martial-arts club.」
lines.3: 「Ah, Konoe. You look energetic as ever.」
lines.4: 「Senpai, these cream puffs from the shop by the station are popular right now. Would you like one?」
lines.5: 「Oh, cream puffs. You know very well that I like them.」
lines.6: 「Ah... She finished it in one bite. Such elegant, wasted-motion-free movement. As expected of Iron-senpai.」
lines.7: 「Um! There's something I'd like to ask you about. Would that be all right!?」
